services.name: Adventure Balloons Ltd
services.desc: Our hot air balloon flights offer a breathtaking way to experience the beauty of New Zealand’s South Island. Lifting off from Methven, near Mt Hutt, you’ll drift quietly over the vast Canterbury Plains with panoramic views stretching from the snow-capped Southern Alps to the distant Pacific Ocean. Each flight is a unique adventure - shaped by the wind and guided by our experienced pilots who have been sharing this unforgettable experience for over 30 years. Perfect for couples, families, and adventurers alike, our flights promise memories that will last a lifetime.
